Recovery basis:

Consumer compatibility:
PASS Grok v0.3 real installed-curl one-shot fixture

Known unrelated consumer-fixture issue:
Grok v0.3 tests/fixtures/fake_curl.sh hard-codes FAKE-OPENAI-SECRET-7E4B while test_grok_provider.rex supplies FAKE-GROK-SECRET-7E4B. The shipped fake fixture therefore rejects the correct Grok secret. The real Grok curl fixture uses the supplied secret dynamically and passes.

Authority boundary:
- secret values excluded from broker/provider instrumentation
- MappedEnvironmentSecretProvider stores only reference -> environment-variable-name mapping; value is read at acquisition time
- lease retirement clears the broker-held secret string and further reads fail
- current trusted-consumer and legacy direct-lease compatibility surfaces both covered
- no Runtime Registry, WLU, endpoint, prompt or model-response authority in Secret Broker
